items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: naturally after playing with Louie Armstrong so long

ctx.x: Well, I don't know that I care to mention too -- I'll tell you, one, Louie came there one time, Louie Armstrong came there with a manager, who I won't name. And I was always pretty independent. And this manager called a rehearsal Easter Sunday afternoon. And that was unheard of as far as I was concerned. I went home to Pasadena, to my mother and father's house, you know, and things, on Easter.
